title: Correct friction coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: Student must calculate μ = 0.015 using work-energy theorem for stone A's motion from A to O.

title: Stone B's pre-collision speed
description: Important Criteria: Student must compute stone B's speed at point O (5 m/s) using work-energy with correct μ.

title: Collision momentum conservation
description: Important Criteria: Student must apply momentum conservation m v_A' + M v_B' = M v_B (with v_A initial = 0).

title: Collision energy conservation
description: Important Criteria: Student must apply kinetic energy conservation (elastic collision) to set up second equation.

title: Post-collision distances
description: Important Criteria: Student must compute stopping distances for both stones after collision using work-energy theorem.

title: Win condition analysis
description: Essential Criteria: Student must compare stone A's stopping distance to outer circle radius and stone B's to inner circle, concluding Team B wins.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize sign mistakes in work-energy equations or velocity directions in momentum conservation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Check that all calculations maintain consistent units (m, s, kg) without conversion errors.

title: Algebraic solution method
description: Optional Criteria: Award for clean algebraic solution of elastic collision equations rather than numerical guesswork.
